summary: Senior engineer who builds and runs cloud-native platforms and takes products from idea to working reality. Today I design and operate the Kubernetes/OpenShift foundation behind Slovakia’s national e-government — provisioning clusters as code and owning the GitOps and supply-chain security underneath. Backed by years of full-stack delivery and engineering leadership on a SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies, plus a continuing thread in applied AI — from a deep-learning master’s thesis to fine-tuning generative models.
